title: React Native Reanimated DnD Web Adapter
summary: Adds parity-compatible web drag, drop, and sortable behavior while passing native usage through to react-native-reanimated-dnd.
purpose: Let cross-platform React Native consumers use a single drag-and-drop package boundary on native and web.
responsibilities: Pass native imports through to the upstream react-native-reanimated-dnd package.
Provide browser implementations of draggable, droppable, provider, hook, and sortable behavior.
Translate DOM geometry and pointer interactions into the upstream-compatible public surface.
boundaries: Does not own the upstream native drag-and-drop implementation.
Does not provide application-specific drag policy or persistence.
Does not replace React Native Reanimated, Gesture Handler, or Worklets.
audience: React Native and Expo applications that also render on the web.
Libraries requiring parity-compatible drag-and-drop primitives across platforms.
useCases: Use upstream drag-and-drop behavior unchanged on native platforms.
Render draggable and droppable interactions in React Native Web.
Build sortable web collections behind the same package import.

architecture.role: Platform adapter selecting native passthrough or browser-specific implementations at the package entrypoint.
invariants: Native resolution remains an upstream passthrough.
Browser behavior preserves the documented public type surface.
DOM measurement remains isolated to web-owned modules.

limitations: Web parity is limited to behavior implemented by this adapter.
Consumers must provide compatible React Native, Reanimated, Gesture Handler, and Worklets peers.
